stem: Simplify, giving the answer in simplest form: $\frac{{=m}x+{=a}}{x+{=p}}-\frac{{=n}x+{=b}}{x+{=p}}$ (the domain is $x\neq -{=p}$).
solution: The denominators are equal, so subtract the numerators over the common denominator: $\frac{({=m}x+{=a})-({=n}x+{=b})}{x+{=p}}$.
Remove the brackets and collect like terms: $({=m}-{=n})x+({=a}-{=b})={=m-n}x+{=a-b}$.
The result is $\frac{{=m-n}x+{=a-b}}{x+{=p}}$; it cannot be simplified further, and the domain is $x\neq -{=p}$.
